alex: acked — taking first touch. pulling dashboards.

alex: quick notes: 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate. traffic steady ~900 RPS. p95 latency rose from 110ms -> 460ms. No deploys in last 40m per deploy-bot.

maria: checking gateway pods in usw2. some pods showing restarts and OOMs.
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway-usw2
gateway-usw2-abcde   1/2 CrashLoopBackOff  4
gateway-usw2-fghij   2/2 Running          0
gateway-usw2-klmno   2/2 Running          2
```

kevin: tailing logs for crash loop pod. seeing repeated lines:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:01Z ERROR request_id=def456 upstream=kvcache eviction timeout
2026-03-15T02:12:02Z ERROR request_id=def457 runtime: out of memory allocating 256MB
```
Likely large-context requests causing KV cache thrash and OOMs.

dana: product insight: a handful of tenants in usw2 are sending >40k token contexts. Could be the trigger.

alex: mitigation step 1: scale gateway replicas in usw2 to 30, enable temporary routing weight shift for top-3 heavy tenants to eu-west1. Also enable a short-term tightened max_context limit on gateway.

maria: applying config: max_context_tokens=32768 for gateway in usw2 for requests >2k tokens. Rolling to small percentage first.

kevin: applying config via infractl:
```
./infractl config apply --service inference-gateway --region usw2 --key max_context_tokens --value 32768 --rollout 10%
```

pagerbot: config change accepted. autoscaler bumped replicas -> 30. PD incident updated.

maria: monitoring — 5xx rate now down from 4.9% -> 1.1% over the last 3m. p95 latency back to ~200ms. CrashLoop pods recovering.

alex: handing off active monitoring to maria for the next 30m. I'll step out of rotation. @maria you have the page.

maria: taking it. I'll collect logs, create the INC follow-up, and file tickets: (1) per-customer circuit-breakers, (2) gateway backpressure to model-serving, (3) kvcache heuristics.

dana: I'll draft tenant notifications for impacted customers with details and mitigation steps.

kevin: follow-up tech action: add soft-limits and backpressure signals, e2e test for long-context flows. Will open PR and link to RCA.

alex: closing PD alert as mitigated; will update with RCA ticket when created. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
